summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting daily repurchases under its buy-back announced 5 August 2026, executed by BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC. On 14 September 2026 it bought 800,000 ordinary shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average of US$15.3331 (high US$15.5660, low US$15.2980) plus 314,400 shares in Hong Kong at HK$164.0240. Cumulative repurchases total 29,531,814 shares for approximately US$609.6m; shares are cancelled, leaving 17,158,692,183 ordinary shares and voting rights. Watch execution pace, HK cancellation timing and any programme extension.
